spades.name: Points to win
spades.explain: The first team to reach this score at the end of a hand wins.

spades.name: Nil value
spades.explain: Bid zero and take no tricks to score this; take one and lose it.

spades.name: Blind nil
spades.explain: Bid nil before looking at your cards, for double. 0 turns it off.

spades.name: Blind nil only when behind by
spades.explain: A team may bid blind nil only when it trails by at least this much.

spades.name: Blind nil exchange
spades.explain: After the bids, a blind nil bidder passes this many cards to their partner, and the partner passes the same number back. 0 means no exchange.

spades.name: A broken nil's tricks help the partner
spades.explain: Off: tricks a broken nil takes don't count toward the partner's bid; they count as bags for the team instead. On: they count toward the partner's bid.

spades.name: Bags before a penalty
spades.explain: Each trick over the bid is a bag worth 1 point. Collect this many and lose the penalty.

spades.name: Bag penalty
spades.explain: Points lost each time a team's bags reach the limit.

spades.name: Spades must be broken to lead
spades.explain: Nobody may lead a spade until a spade has been played on another suit, unless they hold only spades.

spades.name: 10 for 200
spades.explain: A team that bids 10 or more tricks scores 200 if it makes the bid and loses 200 if it doesn't.

spades.name: Jokers and deuces
spades.explain: Big Joker, Little Joker, 2 of diamonds and 2 of spades are the four highest spades. The 2 of clubs and 2 of hearts are taken out.

spades.name: Minimum team bid
spades.explain: A team's two bids must add up to at least this, unless one partner bids nil. 0 means no minimum.

spades.name: Boston
spades.explain: Took 13: a team that takes all 13 tricks gets 250 extra, whatever it bid. Bid 13: a team that bids all 13 tricks scores 500 if it takes them all and loses 500 if it doesn't. Off: no bonus.

spades.name: Lose at
spades.explain: A team whose score drops to this loses the game right away. 0 turns it off.

spades.name: 2 of clubs leads
spades.explain: Whoever holds the 2 of clubs (the 3 of clubs with Jokers) leads it to the first trick, instead of the player left of the dealer.

hearts.name: Game ends at
hearts.explain: The game ends when someone reaches this score. The lowest score wins.

hearts.name: Shoot the moon
hearts.explain: Take every heart and the queen of spades. Add: everyone else gets 26. Choose: the shooter picks add, or 26 off their own score. Auto: add, unless that would end the game with the shooter losing; then 26 comes off the shooter's score. Off: no special scoring.

hearts.name: Omnibus: jack of diamonds is -10
hearts.explain: Whoever takes the jack of diamonds subtracts 10 points. Some tables call this Omnibus Hearts.

hearts.name: Passing
hearts.explain: Which way three cards are passed before each hand, in turn.

hearts.name: Hearts must be broken to lead
hearts.explain: Nobody may lead a heart until hearts are broken, unless they hold only hearts. A heart played on another suit breaks them; so does the queen of spades when that rule is on.

hearts.name: Points allowed on the first trick
hearts.explain: Whether hearts or the queen of spades may be played on the opening trick.

hearts.name: Queen of spades breaks hearts
hearts.explain: Playing the queen of spades counts as breaking hearts. Off: only a heart breaks hearts.

euchre.name: Points to win
euchre.explain: Play to 10, or to 11 as some families do.

euchre.name: Stick the dealer
euchre.explain: If everyone passes twice, the dealer must name trump.

euchre.name: Canadian loner
euchre.explain: If the dealer's partner orders the dealer up, they must go alone.

euchre.name: Farmer's hand
euchre.explain: A hand of only nines and tens may swap three cards with the kitty.

euchre.name: Going alone, all five tricks
euchre.explain: Points for a player who goes alone and takes every trick.

euchre.name: Defend alone
euchre.explain: A defender may also go alone against a loner, for 4 points on a euchre.

euchre.name: Loner's left leads
euchre.explain: Against a player going alone, the opponent on the loner's left leads the first trick instead of the player on the dealer's left.

ohhell.name: Hand sizes
ohhell.explain: How many cards each player gets, hand by hand: down to one card and back up, or just climbing. Your score after the last hand decides the game.

ohhell.name: The dealer's hook
ohhell.explain: The dealer bids last and may not bid the number that would make all the bids add up to the tricks in the hand, so somebody has to miss.

ohhell.name: Scoring
ohhell.explain: 10 + tricks: take exactly your bid for 10 plus your bid, miss and get nothing. 1 a trick + 10: every trick is a point, and an exact bid adds 10. Minus misses: exact is 10 plus your bid, and you lose 10 for every trick you were off.

ohhell.name: Trump must be broken to lead
ohhell.explain: Nobody may lead trump until a trump has been played on another suit, unless they hold only trump.

whist.name: Points to win
whist.explain: Short whist is played to 5, American whist to 7. Each trick over six (the book) is a point.

whist.name: Honours
whist.explain: A side holding all four of the ace, king, queen and jack of trump between the partners scores 4; three of them scores 2. Tricks count first, and a side one point from game can't score honours.

leaderboards.name: Hearts: best game
leaderboards.explain: Your lowest winning score in a game of Hearts

leaderboards.name: Spades: longest win streak
leaderboards.explain: Spades games won in a row

leaderboards.name: Oh Hell: games won
leaderboards.explain: Every Oh Hell game you've won

leaderboards.name: Whist: games won
leaderboards.explain: Every Whist game you and your partner have won

leaderboards.name: Wins against Extreme
leaderboards.explain: Games won with the computer at Extreme
